req.title: Basic-auth handles special characters
req.statement: The system shall URL-decode <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing against the supplied Basic credentials.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should URL-decode the <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing them against the supplied Basic credentials. This means that special characters encoded in the URL should be correctly decoded and authenticated. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct authentication with special characters, a negative case to ensure incorrect credentials are rejected, and a boundary case to test the handling of empty credentials.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%21word with correct Basic Auth header.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
import base64

# Encode credentials
credentials = base64.b64encode(b'user@example.com:pass!word').decode('utf-8')

# Send request with correct credentials
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%21word', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'})

# Assert response
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'authenticated': True, 'user': 'user@example.com'}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_incorrect_credentials
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%21word with incorrect Basic Auth header.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
import base64

# Encode incorrect credentials
credentials = base64.b64encode(b'user@example.com:wrongpass').decode('utf-8')

# Send request with incorrect credentials
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%21word', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'})

# Assert response
assert response.status_code == 401

tests.name: test_basic_auth_empty_credentials
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth// with empty Basic Auth header.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
import base64

# Encode empty credentials
credentials = base64.b64encode(b':').decode('utf-8')

# Send request with empty credentials
response = client.get('/basic-auth//', headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'})

# Assert response
assert response.status_code == 401
